UNSAT. Proof: For any graph G on n=19 vertices with girth ≥ 8 and m=37 edges (so sum of degrees = 74):

Let d_v denote degree of v, D2 = Σ d_v², P = Σ_{(u,v)∈E} d_u·d_v.

Since girth ≥ 5, the ball B_2(v) has size exactly 1 + S_v where S_v = Σ_{u~v} d_u, giving |B_2(v)| ≤ 19 so Σ S_v = D2.

Since girth ≥ 8, the ball B_3(v) = {v} ∪ N_1(v) ∪ N_2(v) ∪ N_3(v) has all these sets disjoint, with |B_3(v)| ≤ 19. Summing over all v:
Σ|B_3(v)| = 19 + D2 + (2P - 2·D2 + 2m) = 19 + 2P - D2 + 2m ≤ 19² = 361.

So 2P ≤ 342 + D2 - 2m = 268 + D2.

By Cauchy-Schwarz: (Σ_e(d_u+d_v))² ≤ m·Σ_e(d_u+d_v)², i.e., D2² ≤ m(D3 + 2P), giving 2P ≥ D2²/m - D3. Also D3 ≥ D2²/(Σd_v) = D2²/74.

Combining: D2²/m - D2²/74 ≤ 268 + D2, i.e., D2²(1/37 - 1/74) ≤ 268 + D2, i.e., D2²/74 ≤ 268 + D2. This gives D2 ≤ 182.6.

But by Cauchy-Schwarz D2 ≥ (Σd_v)²/n = 74²/19 ≈ 288.2.

Contradiction (288 > 182). So no such graph exists.

import random
from itertools import combinations

def build_with_girth(seed):
    random.seed(seed)
    n = 19
    # Start with random forest / cycle
    adj = [set() for _ in range(n)]
    edges = []
    
    # Start with a cycle of length n
    for i in range(n):
        j = (i+1) % n
        a,b = min(i,j), max(i,j)
        edges.append((a,b))
        adj[a].add(b); adj[b].add(a)
    
    # Try to add more edges
    candidates = [(u,v) for u,v in combinations(range(n),2) if v not in adj[u]]
    random.shuffle(candidates)
    
    added = True
    while added:
        added = False
        random.shuffle(candidates)
        new_cands = []
        for u,v in candidates:
            if v in adj[u]:
                continue
            # Check girth: BFS
            dist = {u:0}
            q = [u]
            ok = True
            for d in range(7):
                nq = []
                for x in q:
                    for y in adj[x]:
                        if y not in dist:
                            dist[y]=d+1
                            nq.append(y)
                q = nq
                if v in dist:
                    ok = False
                    break
            if ok:
                edges.append((min(u,v),max(u,v)))
                adj[u].add(v); adj[v].add(u)
                added = True
            else:
                new_cands.append((u,v))
        candidates = new_cands
    return edges
